 See what the stars have in store for your sign By Snehaa Khanna Sahgal 2 November 2026 Illustration by: Saahir Shetty ( @saahir_shetty ) Leo , things are clicking, and you are sort of star-struck by how they are simply falling into place at the speed of light. This is your week to refine your finances, your goals, and put in place an efficient way to get the ball rolling without it taking a toll on your long-term plans and vision.
 Cosmic tip: Stand your ground and keep moving.
